title: Little Girl Brings Stray Kitten Home to Her 90-Pound Husky
characters: Mia, a cute 6-year-old girl with brown pigtails wearing a yellow raincoat
Mochi, a tiny fluffy orange tabby kitten with big green eyes
Titan, a giant friendly silver-and-white Siberian Husky dog

scenes.narration: Six-year-old Mia found a tiny shivering ginger kitten in the rain and brought him home to meet her giant Husky, Titan.
scenes.action: Cute 6-year-old girl Mia in a yellow raincoat holding a tiny orange tabby kitten in a hallway, introducing the kitten to a giant silver-and-white Siberian Husky dog

scenes.narration: Everyone worried the ninety-pound dog would scare the kitten, but Titan gently laid down and offered his warm furry paw.
scenes.action: The giant silver-and-white Siberian Husky dog lying flat on the floor offering his big white front paw to the tiny orange tabby kitten, while the 6-year-old girl watches happily

scenes.narration: Within minutes, little Mochi was fast asleep on Titan's chest while Mia covered them both with her favorite soft blanket.
scenes.action: The tiny orange tabby kitten sleeping peacefully on top of the giant Siberian Husky dog's chest by a fireplace, while the 6-year-old girl places a soft blanket over the dog and cat

scenes.narration: Now the three best friends wear matching blue scarves everywhere they go! Subscribe if Mia and Mochi made you smile!
scenes.action: The 6-year-old girl, the giant Siberian Husky dog, and the tiny orange tabby kitten sitting side by side on green grass wearing matching blue scarves, smiling at camera
